No memory accesses, pointer arithmetic, metadata/fixture/shape dispatch or mutable-name map writes added. Existing caller publication and snapshot rules untouched.

Only logarithm is shared across routes, assigned on every reachable route before joined label. Polynomial temporary never read on large path; shifted never read on small path. Reused polynomial destination is valid per-instruction read-before-write FMA.
Branch is lane-local; contains no warp/CTA collective/barrier/shared mutation. Divergence does not invalidate participation.
